mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/4b662376e58b-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/4b662376e58b-t1/ws/prep/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_2340 모델링 준비: 시점(TP) 코호트, 특징, 라벨, 분할 키 생성. 학습/평가는 하지 않음."""
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep"
design = json.load(open(WS / "design_2340.json"))
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

pat = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
labs = labs.merge(adm[["admission_id", "admit_time", "discharge_time"]], on="admission_id")

# 1) TP 생성: 입원 후 24..168h, 퇴원 전 시점만 (입원 중 예측)
tps = adm.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tps["tp"] = tps.admit_time + tps.offset_h * H
n_all = len(tps)
tps = tps[tps.tp < tps.discharge_time].copy()
tps = tps.merge(pat, on="patient_id")

cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}

def kdigo_flags(g, eval_mask, base7_min=None):
    """g: 한 입원의 크레아티닌(collect_time 정렬). eval_mask 행마다 KDIGO 충족 여부."""
    t, v = g.collect_time.values, g.value.values
    out = []
    for i in np.where(eval_mask)[0]:
        prev48 = v[(t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h")) & (t < t[i])]
        hit = len(prev48) and v[i] - prev48.min() >= 0.3
        if base7_min is not None:
            hit = hit or (not np.isnan(base7_min) and v[i] >= 1.5 * base7_min)
        else:
            prev7 = v[(t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h")) & (t < t[i])]
            hit = hit or (len(prev7) and v[i] >= 1.5 * prev7.min())
        out.append(bool(hit))
    return any(out)

rows = []
for r in tps.itertuples():
    g = cr_by_adm.get(r.admission_id)
    tp = np.datetime64(r.tp)
    if g is None:
        rows.append((np.nan, False, 0)); continue
    # 제외: tp 시점까지 보고된 크레아티닌만으로 KDIGO 충족
    known = g[g.report_time.values <= tp]
    excl = kdigo_flags(known, np.ones(len(known), bool)) if len(known) else False
    # 결과: [tp, tp+48h) 채취 크레아티닌, 기준선 = [tp-168h, tp) 채취 최솟값
    ref = g[(g.collect_time.values >= tp - np.timedelta64(168, "h")) & (g.collect_time.values < tp)]
    base7 = ref.value.min() if len(ref) else np.nan
    win = (g.collect_time.values >= tp) & (g.collect_time.values < tp + np.timedelta64(48, "h"))
    y = kdigo_flags(g, win, base7) if win.any() else False
    rows.append((int(y), excl, int(win.sum())))
tps[["aki_48h", "excl_aki_known_by_tp", "n_cr_outcome_window"]] = pd.DataFrame(rows, index=tps.index)

coh = tps[(tps.age >= 18) & ~tps.excl_aki_known_by_tp].copy()

# 2) 특징 (report_time <= tp). cr_max_adm 은 창이 discharge 까지여서 누설 → 생성하지 않음
def window_agg(test, agg, start_h=None):
    L = labs[labs.test == test][["admission_id", "value", "report_time", "admit_time"]]
    m = coh[["admission_id", "tp"]].reset_index().merge(L, on="admission_id")
    lo = m.admit_time if start_h is None else m.tp - start_h * H
    m = m[(m.report_time >= lo) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    s = m.groupby("index").value.agg({"last": "last"}.get(agg, agg))
    return s.reindex(coh.index).fillna(0) if agg == "count" else s.reindex(coh.index)

coh["cr_min_adm"] = window_agg("creatinine", "min")
coh["k_last"] = window_agg("potassium", "last")
coh["n_cr"] = window_agg("creatinine", "count")
coh["cr_last"] = window_agg("creatinine", "last")
coh["hgb_min"] = window_agg("hemoglobin", "min")
coh["bun_last"] = window_agg("bun", "last")
coh["cr_max_48h"] = window_agg("creatinine", "max", start_h=48)
coh["sex_M"] = (coh.sex == "M").astype(int)
coh["unit_ICU"] = (coh.unit == "ICU").astype(int)

# 3) 분할: family_id 결측(가족 미연결) 환자는 patient_id 로 대체한 그룹 키 (확인 필요 사항)
coh["split_group"] = coh.family_id.fillna(coh.patient_id)
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = np.array(sorted(coh.split_group.unique()))
test_g = set(rng.choice(groups, int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
coh["split"] = np.where(coh.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")

feat = ["cr_min_adm", "k_last", "n_cr", "age", "cr_last", "sex_M", "unit_ICU", "hgb_min", "bun_last", "cr_max_48h"]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "unit", "offset_h", "tp", "n_cr_outcome_window"] + feat + ["aki_48h"]
coh[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_features.csv.gz", index=False)

summary = {
    "tp_total_before_discharge_filter": n_all, "tp_in_hospital": len(tps),
    "excluded_aki_known_by_tp": int(tps.excl_aki_known_by_tp.sum()), "cohort_rows": len(coh),
    "admissions": coh.admission_id.nunique(), "patients": coh.patient_id.nunique(),
    "split_rows": coh.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_patients": coh.groupby("split").patient_id.nunique().to_dict(),
    "missing_rate": coh[feat].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "outcome_ascertainment_by_unit": coh.groupby("unit").agg(
        rows=("aki_48h", "size"), event_rate=("aki_48h", "mean"),
        no_cr_in_window=("n_cr_outcome_window", lambda s: float((s == 0).mean())),
        mean_cr_in_window=("n_cr_outcome_window", "mean")).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "family_id_missing_rate_patients": float(pat.family_id.isna().mean()),
}
json.dump(summary, open(OUT / "prep_summary.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
